description: The orthogonal visibility graph (OVG) is the routing graph for connectors made of horizontal and vertical segments around rectangular obstacles. From each obstacle corner and each port, a horizontal and a vertical line run until they would enter an obstacle. The vertices are where these lines cross, and the edges join neighbouring vertices along a line. Wybrow, Marriott and Stuckey show that some optimal route, for a cost that grows with length and bends, uses only these edges. `Scene` updates the graph in place when obstacles or ports change, and adds a frame and port stubs for ports with fixed directions.

papers.authors: Michael Wybrow, Kim Marriott, Peter J. Stuckey
papers.title: Orthogonal Connector Routing
